info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Jobs-v3-spec
info.description: The Job Application Listing API enables users to access and retrieve a list of job applications submitted through the careers portal. This endpoint is essential for hiring managers and recruiters who need to evaluate candidate applications and track their status. The API provides detailed information about each application, including associated job postings and candidate data. Typical consumers include HR teams and applicant tracking systems that integrate applicant management functionalities.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a comprehensive list of job applications submitted. It is useful for reviewing, managing, and analyzing job application data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of job applications. It contains parameters that determine the filtering and pagination of the job application results.
